scope: Causal diagnostics, not new policies or method performance claims
roots: All 164 previously frozen roots, including successful and failed histories; do not select winners
first_actions: Preserve selected and forward executable first actions from the repaired deployment policy

conditions.deadline50: Only change continuation task deadline25->50; identical actions/state/human future up to deadline25. Validate extended tape against all103 saved frames.
conditions.no-smoothing: Only change future executable-candidate smoothing .3->0, after the forced first action. Keep safety/risk and time25.
conditions.no-filter: Only disable future test-time safety/risk consumption, after the forced first action. Keep smoothing and time25; collision regressions are preserved, not called improvements.
conditions.explore: Only add future epsilon=.05 to the deployment continuation; four indexed common draws, no change to time/safety/smoothing. Draws are not independent scenes.

activation_rule: Finish A/B/C first. Run deadline50, no-smoothing and no-filter if successor replacement fails to correct the main ranking errors. Run explore only if these fail to explain most remaining realized rank disagreements.
mechanism_measures: whether B/C rank disagreement becomes agreement
learning_causality_limit: A changed continuation can identify execution/contract effects, but does not by itself prove how the historical network acquired its weights.
training_selection: At most one factor may receive matched causal retraining; select the factor that most consistently reconciles B with C and explains actual failures without solely relying on collision-producing changes. Register and commit exact factor/control before retraining.
stop: No sweep, extra scenarios or algorithm. If no factor has a discriminating effect, retain the unresolved learning/distribution alternatives and specify one further experiment instead of forcing a root cause.
